entries.sourceEnglish: Check the market rules and local trading and food requirements. An informal stall does not automatically have no rules or costs.
entries.candidateInPacket: Hlahloba melao ya mmaraka le ditlhoko tsa lehae tsa kgwebo le dijo. Setala sa informal ha se bolele ka boyona hore ha ho na melao kapa ditjeo.

entries.sourceEnglish: A smallholder has inconsistent weekly production — surplus some weeks, little in others. Which channel suits her best?
entries.candidateInPacket: Molemi ea nang le polasi e nyenyane o na le tlhahiso e sa tšoaneng beke le beke — ho ba le masalla libekeng tse ling, ’me ho be le ho fokolang libekeng tse ling. Ke mocha ofe oa thekiso o mo loketseng?
entries.repairedCandidate: Molemi ea nang le polasi e nyenyane o na le tlhahiso e sa tšoaneng beke le beke — ho ba le masalla libekeng tse ling, ’me ho be le ho fokolang libekeng tse ling. Ke mocha ofe oa thekiso o mo loketseng?
entries.reason: The candidate “Molemi e monyenyane” can mean a small/young farmer, rather than a farmer with a smallholding. This repair makes the farm, not the person, small. Semantic proposal only; fluent Sesotho review is still needed.

entries.sourceEnglish: A smallholder has inconsistent weekly production — surplus some weeks, little in others. Which channel suits her best?
entries.candidateInPacket: Murimi wa tsimu ṱhukhu u na na production ine ya fhambana vhege nga vhege — surplus vhege dziṅwe, ya vha ṱhukhu kha dziṅwe. Ndi channel ifhio ine ya mu tea nga maanḓa?
entries.repairedCandidate: Murimi wa tsimu ṱhukhu u na na production ine ya fhambana vhege nga vhege — surplus vhege dziṅwe, ya vha ṱhukhu kha dziṅwe. Ndi channel ifhio ine ya mu tea nga maanḓa?
entries.reason: The candidate says production “ine ya sa shandukiswaho” (production that does not change), which reverses inconsistent weekly production. Use “fhambana” (vary/differ) to preserve the stated pattern. Semantic proposal only; fluent Tshivenda review is still needed.

entries.sourceEnglish: Garden area or customer count alone does not predict income. Try a manageable arrangement and record the results.
entries.candidateInPacket: Vukulu bya ndhawu ya xirhapa kumbe nhlayo ya vaxavi ntsena a swi vhumbi mali leyi nghenaka. Ringeta arrangement leyi u nga kotaka ku yi lawula, kutani u tsala results.
entries.repairedCandidate: Vukulu bya ndhawu ya xirhapa kumbe nhlayo ya vaxavi ntsena a swi vhumbi mali leyi nghenaka. Ringeta arrangement leyi u nga kotaka ku yi lawula, kutani u tsala results.
entries.reason: “Ndhawu ya murimi” means the farmer’s area and is less specific than the source’s garden area. “Ndhawu ya xirhapa” restores the garden reference. Technical terms retained pending fluent review.
